an5.90:1.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattanti.
an5.90:1.3: Idha bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu bahukicco hoti bahukaraṇīyo vyatto kiṃkaraṇīyesu,
an5.90:1.5: Ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattati. 3.
an5.90:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu appamattakena kammena divasaṃ atināmeti,
an5.90:2.3: Ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattati. 4.
an5.90:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu saṃsaṭṭho viharati sagahaṭṭhapabbajitehi ananulomikena gihisaṃsaggena,
an5.90:3.3: Ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattati. 5.
an5.90:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu atikālena gāmaṃ pavisati atidivā paṭikkamati.
an5.90:4.3: Ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattati. 6.
an5.90:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu, yāyaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā, seyyathīdaṃ
an5.90:5.2: appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā viriyārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā, evarūpiyā kathāya na nikāmalābhī hoti kicchalābhī kasiralābhī,
an5.90:5.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave pañcamo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattati.
an5.90:5.5: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattanti. 7.
an5.90:6.1: Pañc'ime bhikkhave dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattanti.
an5.90:6.3: Idha bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu na bahukicco hoti na bahukaraṇīyo vyatto kiṃkaraṇīyesu,
an5.90:6.4: na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.90:6.5: Ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattati. 9.
an5.90:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu na appamattakena kammena divasaṃ atināmeti,
an5.90:7.2: na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.90:7.3: Ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattati. 10.
an5.90:8.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu asaṃsaṭṭho viharati sagahaṭṭhapabbajitehi ananulomikena gihisaṃsaggena,
an5.90:8.2: na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.90:8.3: Ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattati. 11.
an5.90:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu nātikālena gāmaṃ pavisati nātidivā paṭikkamati,
an5.90:9.2: na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.90:9.3: Ayaṃ bhikkhave catuttho dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattati. 12.
an5.90:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave sekho bhikkhu, yāyaṃ kathā abhisallekhikā cetovivaraṇasappāyā, seyyathīdaṃ
an5.90:10.2: appicchakathā santuṭṭhikathā pavivekakathā asaṃsaggakathā viriyārambhakathā sīlakathā samādhikathā paññākathā vimuttikathā vimuttiñāṇadassanakathā, evarūpiyā kathāya nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an5.90:10.3: na riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, anuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ.
an5.90:10.4: Ayaṃ bhikkhave pañcamo dhammo sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattati.
an5.90:10.5: Ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā sekhassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattantī ti.
an5.90:11.4: thero sekhāpare duve ti. 1. Pañc' imā
